$comment: Runtime dependencies the owner has approved, per package, with the reason. Adding one needs the owner's approval in the PR that adds it (AGENTS.md). Dev dependencies are not listed: they are not installed with the package. One of them, geist, is copied into dist as the font files, under its own licence (dist/fonts/OFL.txt). Every version is exact (scripts/check-deps.mjs fails on a range, a tag, an alias or a URL) except those listed in $ranges, the host app's own React and optional peer dependencies, which a package cannot pin.

packages/react.@base-ui/react: Accessible unstyled primitives under every component (foundations: Primitives).
packages/react.cmdk: Command menu filtering and keyboard selection (MIT, pacocoursey/cmdk). Bailey approved it for the Benji primitives.
packages/react.shiki: CodeBlock syntax highlighting; loaded on demand, one grammar at a time.
packages/react.elkjs: Automatic diagram layout (`layout="auto"`), loaded on demand through `diagram-layout` and never from the index. EPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-or-later; used under EPL-2.0, unmodified. The owner approved it (DECISIONS 301). A build input, not a dependency: its file is copied, unchanged, into dist/diagram-elk.js with its licence (dist/elkjs/LICENSE.md), the one copy the package ships (the decider's ruling 2 on the batch B re-check); it is listed in $copied, pinned.
packages/react.playwright: Optional peer: headless Chromium for basalt-diagram-export's default exact geometry measurement (DECISIONS 348). Not installed unless the host installs it; the CLI falls back to approximate headless layout with a warning when absent.
packages/react.react-dom: Peer: the host app's React DOM.

$copied.$comment: Approved packages whose file is copied into a package's dist (they are devDependencies, so the lint would call their entry stale): each pinned to the exact version the copy was made from. scripts/check-deps.mjs fails when the devDependency is gone or drifts.
